        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Account</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_AccountMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Amount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AutoApprove</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ApprovedMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RejectNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProgressEmail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CancelEmail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Paid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Progress</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SupApprove</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Timer_7Days</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Timer_30Days</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Resubmit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Resubmit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Received" name="Expense report received" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Account" name="Employee has an account?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAccount" name="Create new account" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AccountMerge" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review" name="Review report for automatic approval" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Amount" name="Amount under $200?" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Expense report rejected" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Reimbursement paid" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Progress" name="Approval in progress notice sent" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Resubmit" name="Expense report re-submitted" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F01" sourceRef="Start_Received" targetRef="Gw_Account" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F02" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Account" targetRef="Task_CreateAccount" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F03" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Account" targetRef="Gw_AccountMerge" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="Gw_ApprovedMerge" targetRef="Task_Pay" />

</bpmn:definitions>
